summary: Margate should keep its standalone municipal control row. Official City of Margate police pages show an active city-run Margate Police Department with its own chief, headquarters, 24-hour operations, and police public-records workflow, so this is not a Broward sheriff contract-policing or county-replacement case. FDLE's 2020 county-and-municipal report published a substantive Margate municipal row and the 2021 report retained the row but blanked every offense field, while the official FDLE FIBRS workbook has no Margate row from 2021 through 2025 Q2 and the FBI CDE roster still lists FL0062100 as Margate Police Department with is_nibrs false. The current all-fill condition therefore reflects a live-city-police state-publication and repo continuity failure on FL0062100, not target invalidity.
